label: The star-mesh resistors
subgoals: Sum the conductances of all resistors at the node
Multiply the two neighbour resistances by that sum
Repeat for every pair of former neighbours

label: Redistributing the capacitance
subgoals: Compute each neighbour's share of the total conductance
Multiply the node's capacitance by each share
Add the shares to the neighbours' capacitances

label: Which nodes to eliminate
subgoals: Compute each node's capacitance times its parallel resistance
Compare the time constant with the threshold
Prefer low-degree nodes to limit fill-in
